comments.text:
Migrate ChannelStrip and synth-ui components to consume ParamRegistry for labels, ranges, and defaults.

DEPENDS ON: i7-49c.19 (useMixer migration)

CURRENT STATE: Every SynthKnob/SynthFader in the web UI hardcodes label, min, max, defaultValue props. Example from ChannelStrip.tsx:
  <EqKnob label='FX1' value={p.chorusSend} min={0} max={127} defaultValue={0} .../>

CHANGES: Use the ParamRegistry to look up these values by param ID. Components receive a paramId string instead of individual label/min/max/default props.

This is low priority — the web app works fine with hardcoded values. The main benefit is proving the registry is usable and catching any gaps before the VST UI depends on it.

SCOPE: Start with ChannelStrip only (mixer knobs). Do not migrate tone editors in this task.

title: Web: migrate ChannelStrip to use ParamRegistry for labels/ranges
